svg.title: Stoneham square insertion lattice showing the pairwise products of terms
svg.desc: A 6 by 6 grid of cells indexed by i from 1 to 6 left to right and j from 1 to 6 bottom to top. Each cell shows the insertion position 3 to the i plus 3 to the j and the coefficient 3 to the minus (i + j); the grid is symmetric about the diagonal. Positions range from 6 in the corner (1, 1) to 1458 in the corner (6, 6). Twenty-two cells are shaded blue: all pairs with both indices at most 4, plus (5, 1), (5, 2), (5, 3) and their transposes, the pairs whose position is at most 270. Cells (4, 4), (5, 3) and (3, 5) on the anti-diagonal i + j = 8 have an orange outline. Below, a logarithmic number line from about 2 to 1600 shows the 6 insertion positions 3 to the j of alpha in one row and the 21 distinct positions of alpha squared in a second row, clustered just after each power of 3, with a vertical marker at n = 270; positions up to 270 are blue.
